column1: What documents and materials must they give the teacher?|他们要给老师护照、签证和入学通知书。|They need to give the teacher their passports, visas and admission letters.
Where do they choose their courses?|他们在网上选课。|They choose courses online.
What is on their campus?|有图书馆、体育馆、超市和食堂。|There are a library, gym, supermarket and dining halls.
Which students have a chance to get a scholarship?|成绩好、表现好的学生有机会。|Students with good results and performance have a chance.
Why do many international students come to China to study?|随着中国的发展，越来越多的人想来学习。|As China develops, more people want to come and study.
Besides studying, what can they do with Chinese students?|他们可以一起做研究、参加校园活动。|They can do research and join campus activities together.
What major does Chen want, and why?|他想学跟经济有关的专业，了解国际贸易。|He wants an economics-related major to learn about international trade.
Why have Chen and Annie come to study in China?|他们想学习语言和知识，也为将来做准备。|They want to learn language and knowledge and prepare for the future.
Which room is the landlord renting out, and what is it like?|房东出租大房间，房间很亮。|The landlord is renting out the large, bright room.
Why does the landlord say life in the neighbourhood is convenient?|因为小区离地铁站很近。|Because the neighbourhood is near a subway station.
Why is Li worried that Bai may not rest well on weekends?|因为这里的年轻人周末可能会玩到很晚。|Because young people here may stay out late on weekends.
Why does Bai decide to rent this home?|房租合适，环境很好，房东也热情。|The rent is suitable, the environment is good and the landlord is friendly.
What is in Bai's rented room?|有床、空调、书桌和椅子。|There are a bed, air conditioner, desk and chair.
What does Bai plan to buy?|她准备买几条毛巾。|She plans to buy a few towels.
How did Bai find a suitable home?|她先在网上查找，再去看房子和周围环境。|She searched online first, then visited the homes and their surroundings.
Why do many people in China buy a home after working for a few years?|因为他们觉得有房才有家，更有安全感。|Because they feel owning a home brings belonging and security.
Why could Chen not find Huayuan neighbourhood?|他刚来中国，不熟悉路。|He had just come to China and was unfamiliar with the roads.
Why did Chen not use a phone map?|因为很多中文地名他还不认识。|Because he did not recognise many Chinese place names.
What did Li help Chen do a few days ago?|他帮陈天中下载软件，教他用手机支付。|He helped Chen download apps and taught him mobile payment.
What can Chen do with his phone now?|他会扫码结账，也会网购。|He can scan codes to pay and shop online.
What have Bai and Chen learned to do with their phones?|他们学会了支付、网购和寄快递等。|They have learned payment, online shopping and sending parcels.
Why do international students like online shopping too?|因为选择多、价格不高，送货也很快。|Because there are many choices, low prices and fast delivery.
Why do people worry about personal information security?|因为网上购物时要提供很多个人信息。|Because online shopping requires much personal information.
What means do countries use to keep personal information safe?|通过技术、法律等手段。|Through technology, laws and other means.
Why is Chen worried?|手机停机了，他买不了地铁票。|His phone service is suspended, so he cannot buy a subway ticket.
Why does Chen want the person's contact details?|因为他想把钱还给那个人。|Because he wants to pay the person back.
Why is the neighbour not going upstairs?|东西太多，她想先休息一下。|There are many things to carry, so she wants to rest first.
Why does Bai help carry her neighbour's things?|她正好要上楼，也觉得邻居应该互相帮助。|She is going upstairs anyway and thinks neighbours should help one another.
Why does Bai like cycling?|因为既方便，又能锻炼身体，还能保护环境。|It is convenient, gives exercise and protects the environment.
Why are electric bikes becoming more popular?|速度快，价格不高，充电也方便。|They are fast, inexpensive and easy to charge.
What services do many Chinese subway stations provide?|可以买吃的、喝的，有的还可以免费借雨伞。|You can buy food and drinks, and some lend umbrellas free of charge.
What effect do these station services have?|它们让出行更方便，让心情更愉快。|They make travel more convenient and improve people's mood.
Has Bai become used to Chinese food?|她习惯了，也很喜欢中国菜。|She has, and she likes Chinese food very much.
How is Sichuan boiled fish made?|先用水把鱼煮熟，最后倒上辣椒油。|Cook the fish in water first, then pour chili oil over it.
Did Wang's family dare to eat spicy food before, and why?|以前不太敢，因为吃完肚子可能不舒服。|Not much before, because it might upset their stomachs.
What do the two expressions about spicy food mean?|一个是不怕吃辣，一个是怕菜不够辣。|One means not fearing spice; the other means fearing food is not spicy enough.
What did Bai order, and why?|她点了辣子鸡，因为想吃辣的。|She ordered spicy chicken because she wanted spicy food.
How did they pay?|李文先付钱，大家再把自己的钱转给他。|Li paid first, then everyone transferred their share to him.
How can seats be arranged at a formal meal?|可以按照年龄安排，请老人和客人先坐。|Seats can be arranged by age, inviting older people and guests to sit first.
What does Bai think of these seating arrangements?|她觉得这表现了对客人和老人的尊重。|She thinks they show respect for guests and older people.
What is wrong with Bai?|她发烧、咳嗽，身体很不舒服。|She has a fever and cough and feels very unwell.
Why will Li go to hospital with Bai?|她不知道怎么看病，他可以帮她翻译。|She does not know the process, and he can translate.
What must Li write on the form?|病人的姓名、性别、国籍、年龄、电话和地址。|The patient's name, gender, nationality, age, phone number and address.
What does Li ask Bai to do?|让她在大厅休息，不要着急。|He asks her to rest in the lobby and not worry.
What illness does Bai have?|她得了比较严重的流行性感冒。|She has a fairly severe case of influenza.
What does the doctor tell Bai to do in the story?|按时吃药，多喝水，多休息。|Take medicine on schedule, drink more water and rest.
What may international visitors worry about on a first hospital visit in China?|可能担心语言不通，或者看病过程不同。|They may worry about language barriers or different procedures.
What is the hospital process described in the text?|先挂号，再找医生，按医生说的一步一步来。|Register, see the doctor, then follow the doctor's steps.
What is the problem with the colleague's plan?|调查的地点只有超市，不太够。|It only includes supermarkets, which is not enough.
What does Wang advise for the survey?|要细心，了解客户真正的想法。|Be attentive and understand customers' real views.
What does the colleague want to investigate?|了解客户对新产品的看法。|Customers' views of the new product.
What advice does Yang give?|提前准备问题，安排好时间。|Prepare questions in advance and arrange the time well.
What difficulty did the colleague face at first?|她介绍产品的方式一样，效果不理想。|She used the same product introduction for everyone, with poor results.
What did the colleague do later?|她做了调查，根据不同客户介绍产品。|She researched and adapted product introductions to different customers.
Why does the writer advise against frequent job changes?|因为很难积累经验，也可能影响发展。|Because it is hard to build experience and may affect development.
How can young people get better development opportunities?|多学习，提高工作能力，打好基础。|Learn more, improve work ability and build a sound foundation.
Why does Annie want to go out and relax?|因为最近学习太紧张了。|Because studying has been too stressful lately.
What does Annie think of Bai's Great Wall suggestion?|她觉得是个好主意。|She thinks it is a good idea.
Why did Yang often work overtime and stay up late before?|他觉得年轻时要多学多干、积累经验。|He thought young people should learn, work and build experience.
Why does Li say not to put too much pressure on oneself?|因为失去健康就不值得了。|Because losing one's health is not worth it.
What do people now realise makes work more efficient?|休息好了再工作，效率更高。|Working after proper rest is more efficient.
How does Yang usually relax on weekends now?|他去郊区游玩，或者在家看书。|He goes to the suburbs or reads at home.
Where do people go for weekend outings in Beijing?|去公园、长城、故宫，或者郊区。|To parks, the Great Wall, the Palace Museum or the suburbs.
What are farmhouse holiday places like?|吃、玩、住都很方便。|They are convenient for food, recreation and accommodation.
How did Li know Bai liked that chocolate?|他看见她在超市拿起来看了看，又放下了。|He saw her pick it up, look at it and put it back in the supermarket.
What attracted Bai to Li?|他的幽默和耐心吸引了她。|His humour and patience attracted her.
Why could Yang and Wang Yifei become a couple?|他们有共同爱好，也能相互理解和支持。|They share interests and can understand and support each other.
Why does Wang Yixue believe they will stay together?|因为她很了解他们，觉得他们很合适。|Because she knows them well and thinks they suit each other.
What impression did Yang make on Wang Yixue?|他实在、阳光、负责，也很积极。|He seemed honest, sunny, responsible and enthusiastic.
Why does Yang feel lucky?|友情给他带来了美好的爱情。|Friendship brought him wonderful love.
If how love begins is not important, what is important?|在合适的时间遇到合适的人。|Meeting the right person at the right time.
How should love be nurtured?|关注对方感受，相互尊重、理解和支持。|Care about the other's feelings and offer mutual respect, understanding and support.
Why did the young man regret wearing too little?|因为哈尔滨气温很低，把他冻坏了。|Because Harbin's temperature was low and he was freezing.
What advice do Liu and Wang give for travelling north in winter?|提前查天气，一定穿厚衣服。|Check the weather in advance and wear thick clothes.
Why does Chen want to visit Harbin at Spring Festival?|他想看雪，也想参加活动。|He wants to see snow and join activities.
What does Wang Yifei think after hearing their plans?|她也想外出旅游了。|She also wants to travel.
How do Guangzhou and Harbin differ?|位置、气候和方言都不同。|Their locations, climates and dialects differ.
Why do Chinese children learn standard Mandarin?|为了方便交流，减少误会。|To communicate smoothly and reduce misunderstandings.
How can people travel in an environmentally friendly way?|近的地方走路或骑车，远的地方坐公交或地铁。|Walk or cycle for short journeys; take buses or the subway for longer ones.
What should people do about waste sorting?|学习分类知识，从小事做起，积极参加活动。|Learn waste sorting, start with small actions and join activities.
